heading_path: Mapping and Characterizing QTLs: Inbred Line Crosses

blocks.content: The idea behind using marker information to map and characterize QTLs is quite simple: by crossing two inbred lines, linkage disequilibrium is created between loci that differ between the lines, and this in turn creates associations between marker loci and linked segregating QTLs.
